messages:
jamal: Heads-up — bringing umbra-3b into the catalog for the next launch. Need a quick sweep on licensing + perf profile. Who's owning?
ana: I can own the perf profile. ran quick microbench on A10G, batch=1. rough numbers below.
ana: ```
model: umbra-3b
seq: 512
batch=1
latency: 110ms/token
throughput: 3.7 tokens/sec (steady)
GPU mem: ~6.4GB
quant: q4_0 ok for quality, q2_k looks lossy
```
travis: infra note — container + weights size look fine. Need a quantized artifact (.pt or fused) for serving. Also need the model card + sha for reproducibility.
sophia: licensing check: weights are distributed under CC BY-NC-4.0. That is non-commercial; we cannot expose this model via Hosted API or Marketplace. Dedicated & Private ok if customer has rights, but we need a notice in the catalog.
mike: hmm — that blocks Hosted launch. Is there an alternate upstream (umbra-3b-ll) with Apache/Apache-2.0 or MIT? If not, can we request relicense from authors?
jamal: @sophia can you drop the exact copy we should show in the catalog? We should be explicit about Hosted vs Dedicated/Private.
sophia: Use this blurb: "Weights licensed CC BY-NC-4.0 — commercial hosting not permitted. Available for Dedicated and Private deployments only. Customers must ensure compliance with CC BY-NC terms." Also add link to license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
ana: ok. On perf side, q4_0 profile attached (I'll upload artifacts to model-storage). Quality check: small eval set shows negligible drop vs fp16 for prompt completions.
jamal: @travis what's minimum infra work to support catalog entry (Dedicated/Private-only)?
travis: create model bundle, tag as "no-hosted" in metadata, add license field. We need the quantized artifact, model card, and a short perf profile JSON. Should be ~1 engineer day to wire the bundle and ~half day for e2e test.
mike: product asks for fallback plan — if authors relicense, we can flip flag and enable Hosted. For now mark as gated and add note on catalog launch checklist.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: catalog-ingest/umbra-3b -> canary 1715100000. Auto-checks: model-card present, license tag, perf JSON.
jamal: action items:
- ana: upload perf artifacts + perf JSON (due EOD today)
- sophia: finalize catalog blurb + required compliance checklist (ASAP)
- travis: prepare model bundle template + no-hosted tag (ETA tomorrow)
- mike: update launch checklist to mark "hosted blocked by license"
Please ping in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
ana: copying here — uploading artifacts now.
sophia: will post final blurb in 1hr.
travis: starting bundle template, will ping for review.
mike: noted. updating checklist.
jamal: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for the sweep. If license changes, reopen for Hosted enablement.
